verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a CLI media tool, but the evidence shows no first-party batch capability for applying one operation across many files. Reading 'an arbitrary number of inputs' is about combining streams into outputs within a single job, which is an adjacent feature. The batch-file wrapper a community user wrote is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
